abilities.name: Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma

_curatorNotes: Coordinated attack, authored 2026-08-18. gcsim albedo/skill.go:103 subscribes skillHook to event.OnEnemyDamage while the construct is up: any damaging hit fires a Transient Blossom 1 frame later — Geo, Durability 25, ICDTagElementalArt/ICDGroupDefault, UseDef — behind a 120f status ICD. Talent row 'Transient Blossom DMG' = 240.48% DEF at level 10.
icdGate ABSENT = the standard window, which is gcsim's Default group here; with a 2s proc cooldown that means Geo lands on every third blossom.

⚠️ Two things gcsim has that we do not. It excludes the skill's OWN initial hit by ability name, so our Albedo gets one extra blossom off his own E cast; and it requires the target to be inside a radius-10 area around the construct, which is the positional claim docs/gauge-round-L5e.md refuses to grow a vocabulary for. ⚠️ It also lets a blossom hear ITSELF and therefore tick every 2s with no player input at all — ours never fires off its own output (Raiden's stated rule, and what bounds the chain).

[Hexerei, Luna III] Witch's Eve Rite Passive "Book of Blinding Light" (Fandom pageid 420847, Talent Infobox |info). The whole passive sits under the "Hexerei: Secret Rite" heading, i.e. count-gated at 2+ Hexerei in the party — the base skill text is unchanged. Bullet 1 verbatim: "When Albedo hits an opponent with his Elemental Skill within 20s of using an Elemental Skill, it will generate Silver Isotomas near the opponent that last for 10s. When there are no Solar Isotomas created by Albedo on the field, and as long as Albedo is not downed, a single Silver Isotoma will begin generating Transient Blossoms, just as Solar Isotomas would. There can be up to two Silver Isotomas generated by Albedo on the field at any one time." Not authored as a summon: the spawn gate is a skill HIT and only within 20s of a PRIOR skill cast, the position is enemy-anchored, and the 2-construct pool is outside the summon primitive; blossom emission is the same P3 onHit-from-summon gap as the Solar Isotoma. Bullets 2 and 3 (the two DEF-scaled party DMG buffs) ARE authored — see factionBonuses.

Solar Isotoma is a Geo construct that emits Transient Blossoms (DEF-scaling Geo damage, 2s ICD) when an enemy inside its area takes damage. Blossom emission is NOT a summonTick (P3 v1) — it's an onHit-from-summon trigger gated by player damage events landing within the Isotoma area. P3 v1 only covers periodic ticks; the onHit-while-summon-active primitive is a separate future extension.

↻ 2026-08-18: THE PRIMITIVE SHIPPED and the Transient Blossom is AUTHORED — the summon-hosted `onHit` damage proc of the coordinated-attack round (sim/procs.ts `takeHitProcs`, armed off the summon's own liveness) is exactly the "onHit-while-summon-active" extension the note above defers. The effect sits on this summon's `effects[0]`, carries its own `application[]`, and therefore produces aura-lane applications, aura-log rows and tick markers on the Isotoma's lane. ⚠️ Two clauses of the old note SURVIVE and should not be swept away with it: emission is still NOT a `summonTick` (it is event-driven, so its markers are published by the parse as `TimelineWindow.ticks` via `ProcListener.tickKey` → finalize, ⛔ never derived by `collectSummonTicks`), and the Isotoma-area positional gate is still unmodelled (the class docs/gauge-round-L5e.md refuses to grow a vocabulary for) — see the effect's own notes for what gcsim has that we do not. ⚠️ The Silver Isotoma note above also cites the "same P3 onHit-from-summon gap" as part of its reason for staying unauthored: that half is gone, but its other three reasons (skill-HIT spawn gate within 20s of a prior skill cast, enemy-anchored position, 2-construct pool) each stand on their own, so the verdict is unchanged.
Recasting E spawns a fresh Solar Isotoma and replaces the prior one (gcsim Constructs.New replace=true) — captured as terminatesOn: "recast".
Construct also acts as a climbable platform / blocker; not relevant for the planner.

[A7] Dropped from the user caveat for length: the emissions are on-hit-from-summon (they trigger when a hit lands inside the construct's field, not on a periodic tick). Mechanism already detailed in the curator notes above.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — Missing summon lanes. With 2+ Hexerei the game puts up to two more constructs on the field, one of which emits Transient Blossoms exactly as the Solar Isotoma does — so a Hexerei-team player sees ONE lane with blossom tick markers where they expect up to two more, and correspondingly fewer aura-lane Geo applications. NOTE: this entry is also the promotion target for the orphaned effect-level caveat at :378 below; the merged two-sentence text is given there. Category: expected-but-absent.
abilities.description:
Albedo creates a Solar Isotoma using alchemy, which deals AoE Geo DMG on appearance.

Solar Isotoma
has the following properties:
·When opponents within the Solar Isotoma field take DMG, the Solar Isotoma will generate Transient Blossoms which deal AoE Geo DMG. DMG dealt scales off Albedo's DEF. 
·Transient Blossoms can only be generated once every 2s.
·When a character is located at the locus of the Solar Isotoma, the Solar Isotoma will accumulate Geo power to form a crystallized platform that lifts the character up to a certain height. Only one crystallized platform can exist at a time.
·Solar Isotoma is considered a Geo construct. Only one Solar Isotoma created by Albedo himself can exist at a time. 

Hold to designate the location of the skill.

abilities.name: Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide
_curatorNotes: Burst fires in two phases: Tectonic Tide initial hit at frame 75, then up to 7 Fatal Blossoms starting at frame 145 (each 5 frames apart) — but only if Solar Isotoma is active. Both phases happen inside the cast animation so we author as instant; per-blossom timing is not separately rendered.

Cancel frames (swap 93 / D 95 / J 94) reflect the full burst animation, not the initial hit at 75. Albedo can be swapped earlier in practice via the construct's queueing — gcsim's CanQueueAfter is burstFrames[ActionSwap]=93, treating that as the canonical animation length.

The verdict "not modelled / nothing authored" is unchanged, on two reasons that were always the real ones: (1) both bonuses are pure damage-MAGNITUDE adds on an existing hit — no new instance, no stat to show — which the tool constitution puts out of scope; (2) the <50% HP gate is unanswerable, `enemyHpBelow` falls through the single `return null` at sim/conditions.ts:201-210 and `ConditionContext` carries no HP or enemy state at all, so it could only ever render assumed-true. ⛔ Do not re-open either of these on the strength of the blossoms now existing.

constellations.name: Flower of Eden
_curatorNotes: 1.2 Energy regen for Albedo per Transient Blossom. Not modelled — depends on blossom emission (P3 gap).

↻ 2026-08-18: reason corrected. Blossom emission is no longer a gap (summon-hosted `onHit` damage proc, coordinated-attack round), but the C1 energy still cannot be authored, for two independent reasons. (1) A proc fires DAMAGE only: `procEffects` rejects any effect whose `type !== 'damage'` and any damage effect with no `application[]` (sim/procs.ts:156-159), so an `energy` effect hung on the same trigger would be accepted by nothing. (2) An `energy` effect has no planner consumer in any case — the only reader in src is `deriveCapabilities` (deriveCapabilities.ts:300), which makes it a Team Builder capability claim and never a bar or a marker. ⏭ Work item only if a proc is ever allowed a non-damage payload; energy display is a separate, larger gap.

[Hexerei, Luna III] Current-patch C1 addition: "Additionally, the use of Albedo's Elemental Skill Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma also increases his DEF by 50% for the next 20s." PERMANENT per Nate's ruling 2026-07-29 (Fandom's |buffType = Hexerei marker is wrong here; gamewith.net article 71629 agrees it's a permanent kit change) — authored below as a plain C1 effect, moved out of factionBonuses.

constellations.name: Opening of Phanerozoic
_curatorNotes: Fatal Reckoning: Transient Blossoms grant up to 4 stacks (30s); Q consumes all stacks, each adding 30% DEF flat damage to Fatal Blossom + Tectonic Tide DMG. Not modelled — depends on blossom emission (P3) and stack-count gating (deferred). Removed the prior placeholder damage effect that was modelling a single stack incorrectly.

[Hexerei, Luna III] Fandom "Opening of Phanerozoic" Constellation Infobox |buffType = Hexerei, |buff appending: "Additionally, when Albedo is not on the field and when the stack count of Fatal Reckoning reaches 4, all stacks of Fatal Reckoning are consumed. This generates 3 Fatal Blossoms near your character, which will violently bloom to deal AoE Geo DMG equal to 300% of Albedo's DEF, DMG that will also be considered Elemental Burst DMG. Where the Passive Talent Homuncular Nature has also been unlocked, the Elemental Mastery of nearby party members will also increase by 125 for 10s." Count-gated at 2+ Hexerei. The re-applied 125 EM party buff IS effect-worthy in principle, but its only trigger is "Fatal Reckoning hits 4 stacks while off-field", and stacks accrue from Transient Blossoms, which are unmodelled (P3 gap) — no honest trigger exists, so it is caveated rather than authored. Revisit once the onHit-from-summon primitive lands.

↻ 2026-08-18: the primitive LANDED and the blossoms are modelled — so "depends on blossom emission (P3 gap)" is no longer the reason for either note above. The conclusion survives on a sharper one: ⚠️⚠️ A PROC LANDING NEVER ENTERS THE HIT STREAM. `fireProc` announces its damage through `notifyDamage` (sim/aura.ts:356), which offers the hit to other proc listeners and stops there — it is deliberately NOT `dispatchHit` (sim/run.ts:327), so a blossom never reaches `ctx.hitRecords` and never reaches `dispatchGainStacksOnHit`. A Transient Blossom therefore cannot grant a Fatal Reckoning stack, and the Hexerei branch's "4 stacks while off-field" has nothing to hang on either. ⚠️ Stack-count GATING itself is no longer the deferral it was — `stacks` conditions resolve definitively (sim/conditions.ts) and `consumeStacks` now dispatches on `onHit` as well as `onCast` — so ⛔ don't cite it as a blocker; the single blocker is the hit-stream exclusion. ⏭ Real work item if proc landings are ever admitted to `dispatchHit` (the L5e finalize-time ordering rule is what keeps them out).

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — A missing +125 EM TEAM buff bar — the one bar-shaped thing in this caveat, and one a C2 Hexerei-team player would look for in the team lane. It is genuinely unreachable: a Transient Blossom is a proc landing and never enters the hit stream (`fireProc` → `notifyDamage`, deliberately not `dispatchHit`), so Fatal Reckoning stacks cannot accrue and the trigger has nothing to hang on. The 'extra Geo DMG' half is damage magnitude with no pixel — cut. Constellation gating already limits this note to C2+ readers, which is the right audience. Category: expected-but-absent.

factionBonuses.name: Secret Rite: Solar Isotoma
factionBonuses.description: When 2+ Hexerei members are in the team, creating a Solar Isotoma raises the whole party's Normal, Charged, Plunging, Skill and Burst DMG by 4% per 1,000 of Albedo's DEF for 20s (max 12%).
_curatorNotes: [Hexerei] 2026-08-15: SPLIT into two entries. Both bullets are one rite, but they are two buffs that STACK in game (Solar: whole party, cap 12%; Silver: Hexerei members only, cap 30%) and both grant allDmgBonus, so as one entry the planner's one-bar-per-stat-per-source dedup silently kept the Solar effect and dropped the Silver one. `byProvenance` groups by (faction, bonusName), so two entries are two groups, two rows and two correctly-labelled bars — no engine change, and the same shape Venti already uses for his three rite entries. See docs/faction-bonuses-round.md.

Source: Fandom "Book of Blinding Light" (Albedo's Witch's Eve Rite Passive, pageid 420847) Talent Infobox |info, bullets 2 and 3, verbatim: "After creating a Solar Isotoma, nearby party members' Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, and Elemental Burst DMG are increased by 4% for every 1,000 DEF Albedo has for 20s. The maximum increase that can be achieved this way is 12%." / "After generating a Silver Isotoma, nearby Hexerei party members' Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, and Elemental Burst DMG are increased by 10% for every 1,000 DEF Albedo has for 20s. The maximum increase that can be achieved this way is 30%." Both bullets sit under the passive's "Hexerei: Secret Rite" heading, so both are count-gated at 2+.

Stat choice: NA/CA/Plunge/Skill/Burst DMG is authored as allDmgBonus, matching the identical wording already authored on Sucrose's Sevenfold Transmutation. It over-covers reaction DMG, which the wording excludes.
Scaling form: per-1000-DEF expressed as a per-DEF ratio (4%/1000 DEF -> ratio 0.004, cap 12; 10%/1000 DEF -> ratio 0.01, cap 30), the Nilou C6 / Sigewinne C6 convention.

The Silver-Isotoma buff targets "nearby Hexerei party members" only; the schema has no Hexerei-subset target, so target is "team" with the restriction stated in the effect caveat (same approximation Sucrose's large-Wind-Spirit buff uses).

Trigger for the Silver buff is onHit/skill rather than onCast/skill: the Silver Isotoma spawns on a skill HIT, and only within 20s of a PRIOR skill cast. The prior-cast chain gate has no primitive, so the first skill of a rotation will show the buff a cast early — stated in the caveat.
The C1 +50% DEF addition was RE-HOMED to the Flower of Eden constellation as a permanent effect (Nate's ruling 2026-07-29: not Hexerei-gated; Fandom's |buffType marker is wrong there).

No permanent (ungated) kit patch found for Albedo this patch: every changed talent/constellation infobox carries |buffType = Hexerei, and the Witch's Eve Rite Passive page states these enhancements apply when at least two Hexerei characters are in the party.

factionBonuses.name: Secret Rite: Silver Isotoma
factionBonuses.description: When 2+ Hexerei members are in the team, generating a Silver Isotoma raises Hexerei party members' Normal, Charged, Plunging, Skill and Burst DMG by 10% per 1,000 of Albedo's DEF for 20s (max 30%).

_curatorNotes: ↻ CAVEAT PROMOTED 2026-08-19: an effect-level caveat reaches no reader; moved to the entry that renders.

[Hexerei] 2026-08-15: SPLIT into two entries. Both bullets are one rite, but they are two buffs that STACK in game (Solar: whole party, cap 12%; Silver: Hexerei members only, cap 30%) and both grant allDmgBonus, so as one entry the planner's one-bar-per-stat-per-source dedup silently kept the Solar effect and dropped the Silver one. `byProvenance` groups by (faction, bonusName), so two entries are two groups, two rows and two correctly-labelled bars — no engine change, and the same shape Venti already uses for his three rite entries. See docs/faction-bonuses-round.md.

[Hexerei] The Silver Isotoma gate — a skill HIT within 20s of an EARLIER skill cast — is not expressible (there is no nth-cast or since-last-cast primitive), so this fires on every skill hit. That is wrong on the FIRST cast of a rotation and right from the second onward, because the skill cooldown is 4s: any real rotation is inside the 20s window from the second E on. Chosen over dropping the effect, which was wrong on every cast AFTER the first. The caveat states it.
factionBonuses.caveat: Not modeled: the Silver Isotomas that 2 or more Hexerei on the team add. Their DMG bonus is shown for the whole party from the first skill hit; in game only Hexerei members get it, and only after a skill hit within 20s of an earlier cast.
